sources.quote: The state had the highest rate of short-stay nursing home readmissions (29.4%) and the highest mortality rate (16.5%) among hospitalized Medicare beneficiaries for major conditions like heart attack and stroke.
sources.searcher_note: Mississippi (named in the prior sentence) has the highest hospital 30-day mortality among Medicare patients, per the Commonwealth Fund scorecard. A statewide rate, not a count of hospitals worse than national.

sources.outlet: Commonwealth Fund, State Health Data Center
sources.searcher_note: Table row: Mississippi hospital 30-day mortality 16.5% vs 14.4% U.S., CMS Hospital Compare, July 2020-June 2023. Same direction, different definition (state rate vs hospital count).

sources.outlet: Risk-standardized sepsis mortality map of the United States (PMC)
sources.quote: The highest risk-standardized mortality rates were found in Wyoming, North Dakota, and Mississippi, while the lowest were found in Arizona, Colorado, and Michigan.
sources.searcher_note: Pattern: sepsis-only state mortality map; Mississippi in the top group, Southeast cluster (Arkansas, Mississippi). Not the CMS hospital measures.

sources.quote: In Mississippi, your chance of dying from a heart attack is 49% higher, on average, than if you were treated in Colorado
sources.searcher_note: Earliest pattern found: HealthGrades ranked Mississippi last (51st) on hospital quality, with Arkansas and Alabama just above. Old, different measure and window.

notes: Sources name Mississippi and report hospital death rates worse than national, but as a statewide rate (16.5% vs 14.4%), not as a count of hospitals (24 of 72 worse, 1 better). No source found for the four-state figure (43 worse, 4 better vs about 20 and 25 predicted by look-alike hospitals), and no source found arguing Mississippi hospital mortality is at or below national. Aggregator sites (hospitalranked.com, safehospitalsusa.com, hospitallookup.com, curarank.com) surfaced but their pages rendered no matching text; not recorded. Mississippi Free Press 2021 story on in-hospital COVID-19 death rates is a different measure; not recorded. Kept to 5 queries per the coordinator's budget note; query 4 fanned out into a second search on its own.
